QUOTE: `_loader.find()` checks `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME`, then `~/.entropic/entropic/lib/` and `~/.entropic/lib/`, and finally falls back to `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives the order of env overrides, then the default user directory, then the system library lookup. It also names two layouts for the user directory (`entropic/lib/` and `lib/`).
